column3: Fade's job callback (queue_fade): alpha from the job's +0x6c string, steps from the time; time 0 sets at once; the frame slot +0x820 = fade_frame
Shake's work: n > 1000 does nothing; flip interval 1000/(n*0.001*fps) into the job (+0x4c), tempo (+0xa0)
per-object Shake setup: steps = time*fps*0.001, tempo tables for |x1-x0|, |y1-y0|; frame callback shake_frame
draws the object at sign*(x0 +- table[step]); the sign flips once the flip interval has passed
tempo name (byte sum) -> table builder (Dxl2 00441240: 1-(1-t)^3)
table of dist*(1-(1-i/n)^3), i = 0..n
game speed tables at 0x531a5c (ms a frame 1,2,4,8,16,...) and 0x531a90 (fps 960,...,60,...), index byte 0x531a40 = 4
CreateWindow's work: last argument not TRUE clears +0x3c8 (children placed from the screen)
an object's place from its x, y text, from its parent's corner when the parent's +0x3c8 is set
new object: +0x3c8 = 1, place from the parent's when the parent's +0x3c8 is set
empties the text log (ClearBacklog, called from 0040d680)
SetFont: applies the font settings (called from 0040d760; face, size, colours, weight, outline)
LoadFont: pre-renders the characters' glyphs into a font object (called from 004094d0)
wait for a timed builtin: true with time > 0 waits the whole time, a number n waits n ms, 0/false/null/missing no wait
SetFrequency: sound object step (called from 0040d220)
SetAlias: clears the alias from its holder, stores it on every object the name matches
SetShade: object step (called from 0040c710; passes the level to 0044af20, not read)
SetNextFocus: both names must match objects (keyboard focus link, not read)
Delete: every object the name matches (wildcards, @ aliases); locked ones stay, children go with it
WaitAction/WaitFade/WaitMove/WaitPlay: wait until nothing runs on the object
timed builtins: steps = time * fps * 0.001 (fps 60), at least 1; time 0 sets at once
timed builtins: steps from the time (with 00437980)
Rotate: x, y, z degrees; @ relative, no special values
SetVertex: unknown before any SetVertex; a clip puts it at the clip's centre
WaitAction/WaitFade/WaitMove: second wait helper (with 00433bf0)
Delete: second step (called from 0040a660, with 00433b00)
Request Start: processes only; the process thread set to run (state 0x13, its event set)
tempo (easing) tables 00440f10-004413c0 (start)
tempo (easing) tables 00440f10-004413c0 (end)
ClearScore: LOCAL/GLOBAL/ALL (with 0040d4f0, 00448340)
ClearScore: LOCAL/GLOBAL/ALL (with 0040d4f0, 004482e0)
MoviePlay: turns skip off; plays full screen, the script waiting (called from 0040d3a0)
MoviePlay: window callback that stops the movie (called from 0040d3a0)
Save: slot atol, then this (the save itself not read)
CreateSound type: BGM, SE, VOICE, SILENT (exact, upper case, a digit may follow) pick the volume setting; volume 1000
SetVolume: clamped 0-1000; 1000*log2(v/1000) mB, floor -10000; @ relative
SetPan: pan x10 -> DirectSound pan mB, +-10000
SetFrequency: sound step (called from 0040d220); stepped by a thread (0045a040) unless at once
SetLoop: true -> -1, false -> 0, a number -> that count (called from 0040d300)
SetVolume/SetFrequency fade: steps (time x a factor, at least 1) from old to new volume along the tempo's curve (00434ea0)
Wait click: mask 0xb (quit, state change, skip); a click does not end it, skip does (with 0040bd80)
SetVertex: x, y names lower case, per axis left/center/right, top/middle/bottom; another word atol (0)
Fade's work: a job record (+4 time, +0x6c alpha, +0xa0 tempo, +0xc4 name, +0x1d4 callback fade_steps) through job_for_objects under the object mutex, then waits as timed_wait (EBX the wait argument)
runs a job record on every object its name (+0xc4, `/` paths, `*` wildcards) matches, from the owner's object: job_apply per path part
calls the job's callback (+0x1d4) on each matching object along the sibling chain (+0x8b8), into children (+0x8bc)

the per-frame step: for every object (list 0x50fb1c, node +0xc, next +0x18) calls its frame slots +0x838, +0x820 (fade), +0x828 (move), +0x824, +0x82c, +0x834, +0x83c, +0x830, +0x898; stores timeGetTime at +0x3ac
Move's frame slot (+0x828): x, y, z from the path table (+0x460, indexed by +0x454[step +0x44a]) until step = steps (+0x458), then the end (+0x43c..) and frees the path
Fade's frame slot (+0x820): alpha = start (+0x408) +/- curve (+0x410)[step +0x402] while step < steps (+0x414), into the render record's +0x14
a frame slot with nothing to run (step_objects puts it back when a slot returns < 1)
frees an object's path tables (+0x460, +0x454, +0x45c) and clears its move fields (+0x428..+0x474): a Move replaces the one in flight
